name: xu-xiang/everything-claude-code-zh
description: Chinese translation of a large engineering workflow skill collection covering topics such as API design and general Claude Code workflows. The sample skill read covers API design in Chinese.
install: /plugin marketplace add affaan-m/everything-claude-code then /plugin install everything-claude-code@everything-claude-code. This plugin route is the documented non-pipe route to draft; the README also documents a manual git clone plus install script rules step, which is not the drafted route.
